rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In an address to the nation dated 21 September 2008 and issued by the Presidency, Mbeki says that he had that day handed the Speaker, Baleka Mbete, a letter tendering his resignation as President 'effective from the day that will be determined by the National Assembly', following the ANC National Executive Committee's announcement of the day before.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-09 only. Election, oath, inauguration, resignation announcement, resignation effect and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
